label: Approvals panel
description: The approval stages of a request: who approves each stage, what they decided, on whose behalf, when, and why, plus what is still pending and when it expires. People who may decide a pending step see Approve and Reject right here.
usage: Place it on the request record view, in the side column or in an Approvals tab.
It shows nothing for requests without an approval policy.
constraints: Visible to anyone who can read the record; decisions are checked on the server (approver, delegate, separation of duties).

binding.description: Reads the approval of the page's record.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab reaches each pending step's Approve and Reject buttons; the reject dialog traps focus and Escape closes it.
accessibility.notes: Each step reads as a sentence, e.g. "Manager approval: approved by Jamie Ortiz for Quinn Patel, 10 Oct 14:30".

responsive: Stages stack; decision details wrap below 720px.
